about: By hand: the phase bar of a bill, the one order the Tweede Kamer does not give as data. Each phase names the exact values of the Tweede Kamer that mark it: a `Document.Soort` of a paper of the dossier, an `Activiteit.Soort` of an activity about it that took place, a `BesluitSoort` of a decision on the dossier's own zaak. A phase is done only when one of them is there. Only a dossier of kind Wetgeving, Initiatiefwetgeving or Begroting has phases. `lawgraph curated check --db` names a value no record in the database has (a new spelling of the Kamer is then a value to add).
